notes: Item 19 is present and contains substantial financial performance data. Two main sections extracted: (1) February 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026 Reporting Period table with Session Revenue, Per Session Fee, and Session Days by tier (Professional, Certified, Expert, System Wide); (2) 400K System Historical Performance table showing 12-month peak Session Revenue within first 3 years for franchisees with at least 3 years of tenure. Milestone achievement data (% achieving $100k, $200k, $300k, $400k thresholds) was noted but not captured as separate records as they are count/percentage milestones rather than revenue value distributions. The historical table explicitly includes pre-franchise-model membership data back to 2008 and excludes terminated franchisees. Tenure/session day data not captured as financial performance records. Confidence slightly below 1.0 due to complexity of multi-tier structure and historical cohort definitions spanning pre-franchise era.
